title: Minor visual bug : no graphic in profile settings
body:
When I look at my profile, the graphs at the bottom is not visible (for insulin duration, basals etc).

![Screenshot_20220226-200314_AndroidAPS.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/155855962-723f749d-f608-4896-a302-548959f25e40.jpg)

I need to select the profile to edit in order to have the graphics be filled.

![Screenshot_20220226-200330_AndroidAPS.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/155855976-d27def8c-329d-414c-8630-30d356f9ee2b.jpg)
